boundaries: Independent CPU review from saved tokens, raw request records, all128 saved tensors, source files and target-process native receipts; no project audit_run was repeated.
Formal run uses complete32-layer NOSA and emits all candidate normalized hidden states without LM head. Synthetic cyclic histories do not establish workload representativeness or task quality.
Exact comparisons are against independent empty HBM histories in the same formal run. This does not compare against a trained dense model output.
First and revisit labels follow visit order, not cache miss. HBM session LRU retains one history; NH admits all16 offload histories.
Memory allocated, reserved and device-used observations remain separate; old observed gaps are not implementation preallocations or mandatory deductions.
Uninstrumented whole-request latency supports only this measured trace. MFU API proximity, internal overlap and compute/IO dominance await matching profile/API evidence.
Reviewer CPU execution does not recreate target-process mappings or prove physical peak budgets. Measured process placement remains the recorded hardware/NUMA boundary.
